description: AA2AR + OPRM + OXYR × Boltz × n=60. Tests whether pLDDT correlates with correctness on the AA2AR bimodality.
biological_expectation: pLDDT does not separate correct from incorrect calls (Wave 52.2: pLDDT top-1 no better than random across 4 of 5 backbones).

description: Class B receptor scan on GLP1R and CALCR × 3 backbones × α5-CT partner × n=50. Tests receptor × backbone specificity of Class B activation.
biological_expectation: GLP1R+Gαs α5-CT +3.72 Å on Boltz (works); Ptx CALCR +8.85 Å (Ptx works, Boltz doesn't). Class B is receptor × backbone specific, not 'backbone class ability'.

description: Round-2 pilot: 5 receptors × Boltz × n=5 on the LENB / panelA receptor set.
biological_expectation: Pilot — small n; verdict absorbed into Round 2 aggregate.

description: Round-4 mechanism bundle — MCHR1 + NPY2R + ACM2 + DRD2 + HRH1 mechanism cross-check on Boltz. Part of the Round 4 phase-1 verdict.
biological_expectation: See wave-4 verdicts. Feeds round4_phase1_report.md.

description: 43-receptor post-cutoff silver-set panel on Boltz-2, Arm 1 (holo cognate-Gα) + Arm 2 (receptor alone). The paper's headline anchor for the cognate-Gα mechanism at panel scale.
biological_expectation: Arm 1 hit rate 86.5%, Arm 2 16.3%, Δ +70.2 pp (branch verdict, LIVE headline).

description: Same 43-receptor Task-3b silver-set on Chai-1 (fourth AF3-family backbone).
biological_expectation: Arm 1 hit rate 82.3% — four-backbone panel complete.

description: Same 43-receptor Task-3b silver-set, on OpenFold-3, with the no-Gα and shuffled-Gα factorial arms added.
biological_expectation: Arm 1 hit rate 88.4% (feeds AF3-family mean 85.6% headline).

description: Same 43-receptor Task-3b silver-set on Protenix v2 (the slug also contains 215 OF3 Arm-2 cross-check preds — see notes).
biological_expectation: Arm 1 hit rate 85.1% (Protenix); AF3-family average holds.

description: Track B pilot: ADRB2 × OF3 × n=5. Feasibility test.
biological_expectation: Pilot — n=5; feasibility only.

description: α5-CT length ladder: 5 receptors × Boltz × 5 truncation lengths (5/10/15/20/25 aa). Amendment 10b — monotonic-ladder hypothesis.
biological_expectation: Monotonic-ladder FALSIFIED. Receptor-heterogeneous length threshold (5HT2A always 0%, ADRB1 always ~100% — but ADRB1 arm is A2FASTATrunc, see catalog notes).

description: AA3R + AA2BR × Boltz × 6 ligand conditions (adenosine paralog test). Amendment 10c.
biological_expectation: 3/4 adenosine paralogs show distinct quirks. AA2BR clean negative control.

description: Gαs F376A/L388A α5-tip mutant on 5 receptors × Boltz. Tests whether α5-tip determines AA2AR activation. Amendment 10d.
biological_expectation: F376A/L388A abolishes AA2AR active (0%); 4 other receptors unaffected (100%). α5-tip specificity confirmed for AA2AR.

description: AA2AR × 5 ligand conditions × 7 seeds × n=20 = 700 preds. Depth ablation to characterise AA2AR-Boltz-2 bimodality.
biological_expectation: 3-tier step function documented at n=140 pooled — AA2AR-Boltz-2 idiosyncrasy anchor.

description: AF2-multimer off-lineage comparator: 15 receptors × AF2-mm × {holo-Gα, no-Gα} × progressive seeds (n=5 → 25). The only non-AF3 backbone in the rerun set. Amendment 10h.
biological_expectation: TM6-only: +53.3 pp panel delta at n=15. Multi-axis (Wave 56.0 corrected): +29.5 pp CI [+13, +48] coherent-active. LIVE.

description: Prospective 2nd-receptor test on ADRB2: 8 ligands × n=60 seeds. Amendment 10i. Tests the 'AA2AR quirk generalises' hypothesis.
biological_expectation: ADRB2 0/480 inactive — Spearman ρ null. AA2AR quirk is receptor-specific. Published negative.

description: Apo-state gap-fill campaign — 15 receptors × {Boltz, Chai} × apo × n=20. Fills cells where Wave 50 apo panel had n<20.
biological_expectation: Apo panel: Boltz 11% active, Chai 13.3% active — baseline low on apo, as expected.

description: Second apo-cell top-up (Campaign B): 15 receptors × {Boltz, OF3, Protenix} × apo × n=15. Closes gaps left by w50_2.
biological_expectation: 40/42 non-5HT2A apo cells reached n≥20 (was 54/75 below in Wave 53.3 audit). 2 cells short due to Boltz MSA rate limits.

description: β2AR chemistry-code chain of ladders: L15X + Y18X + L21X + E19X position-scans × Boltz × n=20 each. Tests α5-CT residue-specific packing constraints.
biological_expectation: L15 needs bulky hydrophobic; L21 needs aliphatic-branched; E19 rule: carboxylate/amide OK, charge-flip complete break. Position-specific chemistry ontology validated.

description: 30-receptor × 3-backbone × {holo-Gα, no-Gα} factorial — the cross-backbone test that the Wave-1 mechanism claim reproduces on OF3 and Protenix.
biological_expectation: Arm 1–Arm 2 delta reproduces on OF3 and Protenix; feeds Wave-8 verdict.

description: Alanine scan on 21 peptide positions (p01..p21) × Boltz × n=5. Systematic position-by-position perturbation.
biological_expectation: Per-position tolerance mapped; feeds the L15/L21/Y18/E19 chemistry ontology.
note: Predictions for this slug live outside the v3.2 scan roots. Fresh M2.4 rerun will score them.

description: CaM (calmodulin) + peptide two-lever design: length lever (M13 5-30 aa) × chemistry lever (hydrophobic/charged/polar); tests the 'CaM wraps hydrophobic peptides' rule at n=100. Includes CaM-CaMKII and CaM-apo controls.
biological_expectation: Rule holds: hydrophobic wraps, charged/polar extend. Prospective 16/20 (80%) correct on W4G. 100/100 wrap on Boltz-2, 50/50 on Ptx, 50/50 on OF3 at n=50.
note: Predictions for this slug live outside the v3.2 scan roots. Fresh M2.4 rerun will score them.

description: 6 mechanism controls (M1 ubiquitin / M2 nb60 / M3 α5ct-11mer / M4 α5ct-5mer / M5 α5ct-scrambled / M6 endorphin-β2AR) × Boltz × n=5. Tests whether specific partner types trigger the active state.
biological_expectation: See mechanism_panel_report.md.
note: Predictions for this slug live outside the v3.2 scan roots. Fresh M2.4 rerun will score them.

description: Prospective peptide-design blind test: 15 designed peptides × {Boltz, Ptx, OF3} × n=5. Chemistry-rule generalisation test.
biological_expectation: Boltz 20/25 (80%) correct, Ptx 23/25 (92%) correct — rules generalise.
note: Predictions for this slug live outside the v3.2 scan roots. Fresh M2.4 rerun will score them.
